text: 3) Figure 11.5 Order of operations in resid- ual blocks. a) The usual order of linear X transformation or convolution followed by a ReLU nonlinearity means that each b) residual block can only add non-negative quantities. b) With the reverse order, x m both positive and negative quantities can be added. However, we must add a linear C) transformation at the start of the net- work in case the input is all negative. c) In practice, it’s common for a residual block to contain several network layers.
